summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-N7 admits no external crate. academic-blind-spot links academic-domain, academic-knowledge-state, serde and thiserror as product edges, and academic-capture, academic-consent, academic-knowledge-state, academic-lecture-document, academic-model-run, academic-transcription, serde_json, tempfile, trybuild and uuid as dev edges, all covered by earlier reviewed receipts, and adds one workspace path package. Nothing links into a product binary that was not already there: the two workspace product edges are path packages this repository already builds, and serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt. Build-time-only additions are zero -- there is no build script, no proc macro beyond serde's and thiserror's, and no code generator.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-blind-spot is the P2-N7 boundary: section 23's five states with one refusing precondition each, the field coverage that counts admitted evidence and its five exposure sources, the taxonomy granularity, observation window and exposure minimum the user selects, the four dispositions ADR-003 makes user-only, the skew explanation carried as a distribution rather than as a sentence, and the one bounded taste path an EXPLORE choice opens. It is a separate package from academic-knowledge-state because the separation section 23's coverage sentence demands is then a graph fact rather than a rule: this crate has no name for a mastery level, so a coverage reading that became a score would first have to import one. It is a separate package from academic-gap because GAP is that crate's decision and this crate cannot mint one from a coverage reading.

no_second_ladder_note: Section 23's five states are declared here for the first time and no earlier crate holds them; what this task does not declare is the point. Section 13.1's mastery ladder was fixed by P2-N2 and this crate does not name it at all -- coverage_never_becomes_mastery and the_blind_spot_crate_cannot_name_a_mastery compare the whole set of its use items, reached paths, macros and re-export modules against pinned inventories in both directions and refuse P2-N3's eight mastery spellings over every product file and every public signature. Section 13.3's FreshnessBand was declared by P2-C1 in academic-domain and this task declares no second enumeration and computes no band: LOW_RECENCY_BANDS names two of P2-N3's six by value and the band arrives as an argument. Section 13.2's eight evidence rows and section 13.4's four eligibility checks were fixed by P2-N2, and an ExposureItem wraps an EligibleEvidence rather than declaring a second admissibility rule; WEAK is that crate's own Outcome::Failed rather than a second reading of difficulty. Section 7.4's three primary node types were fixed by P2-N1 in academic-domain and TaxonomyGranularity::tier returns that crate's own EntityKind. Section 15's gap vocabulary was fixed by P2-N5 and there is no edge to it: no_goal_vocabulary_reaches_this_crate refuses ActiveGoal, GoalCriteria, SuccessCriterion, GapCase, academic_gap, Objective, Remediation and Recommendation over every product file, which is what holds section 23's 모든 분야를 균등하게 채우라는 목표를 만들지 않는다.

direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: EntityId, EvidenceId, ScopeId, TimestampMillis, FreshnessBand, Actor, Claim, ClaimObject, EpistemicStatus, EvidenceItem, DomainError, entity_registry::EntityKind and ontology::{TaxonomyNode, TaxonomyVersionIdentity, VersionedTaxonomyImport}. P2-N1's three primary node types are that crate's ontology module, so the granularity the user selects is one of section 7.4's tiers rather than a fourth spelling here and a concept resolves to its field through an import whose identity binds the exact release the scope names. ADR-003's Claim::validate_for_actor is what makes UserDispositionChoice user-only: every automatic actor variant fails that matrix when it attempts the USER_EXPLICIT/USER_CONFIRMED pairing, which is what makes 새로운 AI run이 경고를 되살리지 않는다 a property of the type. FreshnessBand is P2-C1's six and this crate carries one rather than computing it.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-knowledge-state: EligibleEvidence and Outcome. Section 23's coverage counts exposure, and the evidence it counts is the evidence that passed section 13.4's four checks -- so an ExposureItem wraps an EligibleEvidence and has no other constructor, which is P2-N2's `ineligible evidence has no value of the type the projection accepts` applied to a third axis. Outcome::Failed is P2-N2's own record of an attempt that did not succeed, and section 23's WEAK is read off it rather than off a second reading of difficulty. What this edge does NOT bring is the point: it re-exports LADDER, rung, level_token, AutomaticLevel and MasteryProjection, this crate imports none of them, and the_blind_spot_crate_cannot_name_a_mastery compares the whole set of its use items, reached paths and macros against pinned inventories in both directions with a two-sided control on the reader.

dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-capture: P2-L2's begin, its journal and its preflight readings, reached through P2-N2's own lecture fixture file, so the manifest a document is built over is the file the real capture surface wrote.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-consent: P2-L2's consent ledger, capture request and permission scope, because a capture that is not permitted writes no journal and the fixture must pass the same gate a real one does.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-knowledge-state: Declared a second time for the trybuild reason academic-scenario gives: a compile-fail case compiles against this crate plus its dev-dependencies, and an_exposure_item_takes_only_admitted_evidence names that crate's BlockedEvidence to show inadmissible evidence cannot be counted as exposure.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-lecture-document: LectureDocument and NodeId, so section 23's first exposure source -- 강의 -- is a node of a document P2-L4 produced rather than a string this suite invented.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-model-run: CalibrationRegistry and its dataset types, which P2-L3's confidence interpretation requires before a segment exists.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-transcription: P2-L3's run, its provider contract and its transcript lineage, so a document node maps a segment of a real transcript.
dev_workspace_dependencies.serde_json: The wire round-trip in not_relevant_survives_ai_rerun and the whole-set key comparison in no_equalize_all_goal_is_generated, which is what makes a goal added to the finding an extra key rather than a field nobody looked at.
dev_workspace_dependencies.tempfile: The directory a P2-L2 journal is written to. It is a dev edge only; no product file of this crate names it or any other filesystem type.
dev_workspace_dependencies.trybuild: The compile-fail suite. Section 23's limits are types, and the eleven cases under crates/blind-spot/tests/compile_fail assert that each refusal is a program that does not compile with a committed diagnostic. The cases live in this package rather than in academic-scenario's suite for the reason P2-N2 gives: this crate reaches academic-knowledge-state, which reaches academic-ledger, and scenario_crate_has_no_writer_dependency refuses academic-scenario that crate through a dev edge as much as a product one.
dev_workspace_dependencies.uuid: Deterministic UUIDv7-shaped fixture identities. Every identifier in the suite is a SHA-256 of the fixture's own name with the version and variant nibbles set, so no identity is a function of a clock.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-blind-spot is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns section 23's blind spot detector and, for each rule, the value that does not exist rather than the check somebody has to remember to run: the crate has no name for a MasteryLevel and FieldCoverage derives neither PartialOrd nor Ord, so a coverage reading cannot become a score or be ranked against another field's; ExposureClass has three variants and no OUT_OF_SCOPE and no GAP, so a coverage reading cannot reach the two states the user and P2-N5 decide; every StateBasis payload has private fields and a fallible constructor, so an UNOBSERVED basis for adequate coverage and a STALE basis carrying a fresh band are values that cannot be written; BlindSpotScope has no Default and no constant of its type, so the granularity, window and exposure minimum section 23 gives the user cannot be chosen on their behalf; UserDispositionChoice's one constructor runs ADR-003's actor matrix and DispositionLedger has no removal method and no &mut self method, so a model run can neither mint a disposition nor drop a standing NOT_RELEVANT; NeutralPresentation has no field an action could occupy and every string it renders is a sentence the design document itself contains; and TastePath holds one TasteStep and not a list, reachable only from the user's own EXPLORE choice. Its dependency set is minimal and the edges it does not have are the point: no academic-gap, so a goal this engine emitted would first have to be a goal it could name; no academic-freshness, so the band is carried rather than computed; no academic-store, so nothing reaches the canonical writer and no migration is added; no academic-worker and no academic-egress-boundary, so nothing in its closure can launch a process or stage a payload.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, opens no file, reads no clock, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It spells no std::fs, std::net, std::process, std::env or std::time name at all: every instant arrives as a TimestampMillis argument, and the HIDE_UNTIL expiry is a comparison between two of them. the_blind_spot_crate_cannot_name_a_mastery, no_clock_socket_or_file_reaches_this_crate, the_finding_has_exactly_one_producer, the_presentation_carries_no_free_text, no_goal_vocabulary_reaches_this_crate and every_public_signature_is_in_the_inventory in crates/blind-spot/tests/blind_spot_scans.rs compare the whole set of its 49 use items, the whole set of the 5 two-segment paths it reaches through a crate root, the whole set of the 1 macro it invokes and the 12 modules lib.rs re-exports from against pinned inventories in both directions, and run whole-identifier passes for eight mastery spellings, twelve score-folding spellings, eight warning spellings, eight goal spellings and fifteen filesystem, clock, process and transport constructs over every product file, and compare the whole set of its 114 public functions -- module, name and return type -- against a pin in both directions, because five injections spelling none of the names in any of those lists passed every one of them. Its link closure holds nothing that can open a socket beyond libc, which reaches it through academic-policy by way of academic-knowledge-state. Every document, capture, transcript, taxonomy, claim and admitted evidence item in its test tree is synthetic and built in process; no real lecture is read and no network call is made.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-blind-spot links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt; serde_json, tempfile, trybuild and uuid are already-admitted dev dependencies of other workspace packages. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
